name: vertical_tiktok_plain
notes: Plain game-agnostic vertical layout (no Smite item-bar band) for games like Palworld: blurred/darkened static frame fills the canvas (V1), gameplay is the same hand-tuned wide crop as the Smite preset (full source height, canvas-width slice) sitting centered in TikTok's safe zone — tilt +92 lifts it ~29px so its bottom edge ends at y~1573, just clear of the username/description zone, top edge y~289 stays below the top nav. Same Edit-page units as tiktok_preset.json (crop = conformed-image px pre-zoom; pan/tilt post-zoom, tilt positive = up; resolution-independent for 16:9 sources). Nudge in the Inspector and re-capture with: resolve_tiktok.py --preset tools/tiktok_preset_plain.json --save
